description: Russian male voice for Voxprint. Trained only from the public-domain LibriVox recording 'Angelochek (The Little Angel)' by Leonid Andreyev (Christmas Short Works Collection 2009), read by Create (https://librivox.org/christmas-short-works-collection-2009-by-various/). CC0-1.0, free for any use, also commercial. Attribution appreciated. The name Shimon is Voxprint's own and does not imply the reader's endorsement.

Nur mit der gemeinfreien LibriVox-Aufnahme 'Angelotschek (Das Engelchen)' von Leonid Andrejew (Christmas Short Works Collection 2009) trainiert, gelesen von Create (https://librivox.org/christmas-short-works-collection-2009-by-various/).
